name: Azumi Neo
source:
—Giving up—

1st year student at Malenis High School.
A former child actor currently working as a model.
Though a first-year student, he is composed, carefree, and somewhat elusive.
He's not so much oblivious to social cues as he is intentionally ignoring them and doesn't care much about what others think. He comes from a children's welfare facility.

"I'm sorry, okay? Senpai, please cheer up."

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/sullyland/chara/?page=3]official website[/url]]
